For every box the callers give the two agree: the 0-bit case with extent >= 1.0E-7 is 0..1 on each axis, which contains the centre, so block() either way; a thin grid-aligned box was an empty CubeVoxelShape before 1.17, which Shapes.joinUnoptimized short-cuts like empty() (1.16.5 Shapes.java:153-158); a thin box off the grid (a non-empty zero-width ArrayVoxelShape before 1.17) is never given: the oracle's randomBox boxes are at least 0.125 - 6E-7 wide (OracleGeometry.java:80-92) and optimize's merged cells lie between merger lines kept more than 1.0E-7 apart (indirect/non_overlapping/cube lines). create(AABB)'s delegation and DoubleArrayList.wrap are the same values.
